# Kineto

> @dong-gri/kineto v0.10.0 — vanilla-first web motion & media effects library (52 modules, React/Vue/jQuery adapters, zero runtime dependencies). Attach effects with data-kt-* attributes on any markup, including shadcn/ui, Bootstrap, MUI, Mantine, Chakra, Ant Design, daisyUI, Nuxt UI, PrimeVue and Vuetify components.

## Start here

- [Rules for coding agents](https://kineto.dongri.me/ai/kineto.rules.md): principles, attachment grammar, intent → module table, per-library notes
- [Feature contract (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/catgarret/kineto/main/kineto.features.json): every module, variant, public option and default
- [Integration map (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/catgarret/kineto/main/kineto.integrations.json): ecosystems, intents, Figma hints
- [Module reference](https://github.com/catgarret/kineto/blob/main/docs/module-reference.md)
- [Getting started](https://github.com/catgarret/kineto/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md)

## Tools

- shadcn registry: add `"@kineto": "https://kineto.dongri.me/r/{name}.json"` to components.json, then `npx shadcn@latest add @kineto/provider` — index at https://kineto.dongri.me/r/registry.json
- MCP server: `npx @dong-gri/kineto-mcp` (tools: kineto_list_modules, kineto_module, kineto_suggest, kineto_snippet, kineto_validate_options)
- Live demo & playground: https://kineto.dongri.me
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dong-gri/kineto
